_note: Single source of truth for every constant the economics engine uses (ADR-03-001; C13: also the single source for per-mile cost). Any value change MUST bump scoring_config_version and move the previous file to config/history/ so historical scorecards replay under the config that produced them. Leaves are {value, basis, note?, source?}. basis uses Agent 03's short alias (FACT|INFER|REC|UNK), permitted inside 03 blocks by ADR-0004 ruling 7. Owner-policy values carry source=MICHAEL_DECISIONS and are coordinator defaults, NOT Michael-confirmed business truth.
_changelog: 2026.10.1: engine-ready. Formula strings replaced by numeric parameters (p_waste, confidence haircut). vehicle_cost_per_mile is no longer stored; it is derived (fuel/mpg + wear) so it cannot drift from its parts (C13). Added: service confidence checklist, skill proficiency store, license-gated skill list, time-to-cash defaults, service bad-job recovery, distance-ratio-gate radius, YES evidence requirements (sold comps, scope, title, remote verification), service alert rule, evidence search order. Threshold values unchanged from 2026.10.0. C14 resolved by keeping the YES rule (EV profit/hour >= target) and correcting AT-14; see docs/decisions/ADR-03-002-round-two-engine.md.

vehicle_mpg.note: work truck; item logistics may override per vehicle

wear_per_mile.note: tires + maintenance + depreciation. v = fuel/mpg + wear = 0.4578/mi; IRS all-in ~0.70/mi is a cross-check only

w_min_per_hour.note: absolute floor; deterministic profit/hour below it is a hard PASS. Also prices Michael's travel time in the distance-ratio gate and wasted-trip EV

w_target_flip_per_hour.note: EV profit/hour required for a flip YES

w_target_service_per_hour.note: EV profit/hour required for a service YES

risk_capital_per_deal_cap.note: max cash tied up in one deal; above it is a hard PASS (escalation is Agent 05's budget ledger, not the engine)

max_loss_cap.note: largest single-deal loss tolerated (worst branch with non-zero probability)

f_diag_parts_fraction_on_fail.note: fraction of parts spent before discovering the repair fails

flip_dom_days_default.note: used only when neither holding.expected_hold_days nor resale.expected_dom_days is supplied

service_hours_per_job_day.note: job_days = ceil(labor_hours / this) when job.job_days absent

revenue_recovered_if_job_goes_bad.note: bad-job branch (rework / dispute / nonpayment): deposit + this fraction of the remaining balance is collected

skill_fit_high_threshold.note: derived evidence item skill_fit_high = skill_fit >= this

beyond_normal_radius_penalty.note: subtracted from confidence beyond distance_rules.normal_radius_miles_one_way (no casual revisit)

require_repair_scope_known_for_yes_flip.note: a guessed fault caps a flip at MAYBE (§15)

normal_radius_miles_one_way.note: Conway / Central AR; beyond it the confidence penalty applies

distance_ratio_gate_beyond_miles.note: hard gate (§13-1) applies only beyond this; inside it travel is already priced through cash + profit/hour

skills._note: Skill-proficiency store (gap 2). Coverage uses Michael's stated skills (FACT); proficiency levels are REC priors that LEARN updates via a config bump. A required skill not listed here counts as NOT covered.

license_gated_skills.note: Agent 05 owns the authoritative allow-list; a required skill here that is not in licenses_held is a hard PASS

evidence_search._note: Order in which missing evidence is tried when naming cheapest_decisive_evidence (cheapest first). REC.

trim_each_side.note: drop this many lowest and highest sold prices when n >= 5
